cohort: Women who underwent Cesarean section at Salmaniya Medical Complex, Bahrain, in 2008 (n=3,385) and 2018 (n=3,385)
finding: The rising trend of CS in Bahrain is justified by a significant increase in non-reassuring fetal heart rate (NRFHR) and maternal request as indications for CS, with the increase more pronounced among non-Bahraini women.
